title: aster ageratoides var. laticorymbus
intro: Aster ageratoides var. laticorymbus, commonly known as White Aster, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of White Aster are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which may exhibit anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant activities. However, further research is necessary to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using White Aster as a medicinal plant.
